This '''mission''' was an attack by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] on an Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] near [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], with the objective of freeing several valuable Rebel [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] held inside. It was successful.
